Title: Three.js runtime foundation and host component
Purpose: Implement the JS-owned WebGL runtime foundation, host-state lifecycle, label overlay shell, and the first interactive component wrapper for the new library.
Deliverables: Initial WebGL runtime foundation built around a JS scene host and a global `window.CanDoItAll.webglWorkbench` entry.
Perspective-capable camera controls, scene lifecycle, fit/focus/update/dispose flows, and deterministic test mode hooks.
DOM label/accessibility/automation mirror shell aligned with the scene host.
ReviewQuestions: Does the runtime clearly own the frame loop and hit-testing?
Are label clarity and automation hooks available from day one?
Did the component wrapper stay thin?
CorrectiveOnFailure: If this task fails, stop immediately and execute `subbundles/_corrective-renderer-boundary-reset` before continuing.
